shortDescription: Perform cluster shutdown or dryrun shutdown

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: The version of API to call. If omitted, will use highest version on the system.

options.name: dryrun
options.description: Perform an optional dry run to check whether it is safe to shut down. The default value is false.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting cluster shutdown request id, the default value is 1800 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
